jobs.prompt: Opus review s4s5-sec3b lows to fix. (1) T-0111 tools/board-owner-actions.mjs ~line 67: guardArgs passes item.kind as the guard's decision kind, but guardBoardAction (tools/board-action-guard.mjs) allows only kind 'approve'|'deny' with itemKind the item's kind, so once wired every owner action would be refused. Fix: in decide, after validating body.decision, call guard({ kind: body.decision, source: 'board', itemKind: <the single item kind> }); in prepare call guard({ kind: 'approve', source: 'board', itemKind }) only to refuse refused item kinds early (document it). Keep the kind-mismatch refusal and every other check. Add a test using the REAL guardBoardAction (import it in the test) proving an approve and a deny of an allowed item kind succeed end to end, and a refused item kind (deploy) is refused. (2) T-0123 tools/watch-assets/board-owner-actions.js ~line 31: the client refused-kind check is case/whitespace sensitive; normalize with trim().toLowerCase() and match a refused word exactly or followed by a separator (-, _, :, space, .), the same rule as tools/board-action-guard.mjs (copy the rule; the browser module cannot import node modules). Test ' Deploy' and 'MERGE-request' get no controls. Do NOT touch tools/watch-server.mjs, tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs tests/board-action-guard-unit.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-ui.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests only name these files as ledger data or module lists; the coordinator runs the full suite.
